STILL SHOP HOMEWORK — anchored list

**SPINE.md:**

1. Part I §2 — *"This clause OWNS the consent gate. It is deliberately restated at the dispatch gate and THE COUNCIL: a reflex wants redundancy, and the Amendment Law prefers the rule that leaves a trace."* — cites the Amendment Law, cut today. Dangling shop history.
2. Part I §2 — *"an external multi-agent writeup measured ~15x the tokens of a single chat — their number, not a law of nature; the gate exists because of that shape"* — what we read, not what a stranger does.
3. Part IV — *"a spend limit protects CASH and not a prepaid ALLOWANCE, and an agent can exhaust the month's included pool without charging a further penny"* — this shop's billing scar.
4. Part VI preflight — *"an Antigravity/Gemini host running a Claude model is a Claude lineage"* — this shop's hosts as example; the law (*"independence compares the effective model + lineage, and only that"*) stands without it.
5. Tickets — *"boss ruling 2026-07-24: this line lives in the ticket's small print and is never narrated in the story voice"* — dated ruling.
6. Episode folder, entire style law — *"Style law (boss ruling 2026-07-24): the DATE is for the backend only"* · *"One sanctioned exception (boss amendment, same day): the ENDING CREDITS — show tiers only"* · *"filmed on location · 2026-07-23 → 2026-07-24"* · *"The dispatch deck does NOT roll credits"* — show-tier ceremony, dated, irrelevant to a stranger's plain first job.
7. Visuals — *"(boss ruling 2026-07-24)"* · *"cap ~1280px on the long edge, quality ~70"* · *"uploads arrive under `.claude\uploads\`"* — this box's paths and compression settings.
8. The three flips — *"The builder seat has flipped for three causes — capability, price, infrastructure — and in each flip the cold reviewer surfaced defects the builder missed"* + *"Practical scars:"* — scar narrative; its lessons already live in Review dispatch (*"hand the reviewer the code itself via stdin"*) and the ticket's load-bearing line.
9. Part VIII — *"bumped r1 → r2 on 2026-07-22, when 'another vendor's account' was tightened"* — block-id archaeology.
10. Heading archaeology — *"(Boss ruling 2026-08-24.)"* (Meter Law) · *"v2.3, rewritten v2.5 on the boss's ruling 2026-08-24"* (Council Seat Law) · *"added v2.0, 2026-08-22"* (Transport Law).
11. Council Seat Law wiring italic — *"`mcp-seats/allowance.py` holds the record"* — this shop's code path.
12. THE NOTATION — *"Kept in the trunk on the 2026-08-24 council's ruling"* · *"v4.2 (boss-adopted 2026-08-23)… (v4.0 repealed the 2026-08-09 marks, including 🟣-as-building.)"* · *"that is its birthplace and its meaning"* · *"🌙 Moonshot (Kimi) · 🔷 Zhipu (GLM) · 🎼 Cursor (Composer)"* · *"🟣➤🌙 💸 Kimi K3 reviewing"* — rulings, repealed-mark history, this shop's pool families.
13. Wiring triggers — *"three triggers:"* followed by **four** bullets, the fourth (*"before a LINEAGE REVIEW or a SPEND READING"*) boss-invoked shop process.

**SKILL.md:**

14. *"Reserved future rebrand, coined 2026-07-17: 'Agentic Dispatch Director' — also ADD."* — naming history (also in frontmatter).
15. THE LEGEND — *"this file carried a stale v4.0 against SPINE's v4.2 for two days… Both of those were repealed marks being rendered on live lines."* — incident scar. The rule is one line: *"Read THE NOTATION in SPINE and render it plain."*
16. FUEL MODE, entire section — *"the boss's brain runs on an interest-based nervous system"* — this boss's personalization, loaded on every stranger's summon.
17. PERSISTENT SEATS — *"`wmw-codex` / `wmw-grok` / `wmw-gemini"`* · *"`C:\Sync\Projects\andersons-dispatch-deck\mcp-seats\`"* · *"the two headless croak-killers found 2026-08-22: a 60-minute timeout (agy's default was 5 minutes)"* — server names, absolute paths, dated scars.
18. RESERVE BENCH — *"`BENCH-LEDGER.md`… `mcp-seats/read-meters.py` and `bench-burn.py`"* — `bench-burn.py` was cut today; dangling reference. The whole section is this shop's pool wiring.
19. Step 3 — *"the Overflow Valve, billed to Google's tab"* — this shop's named trick.
20. Step 4 — *"This shop's wiring (`SPINE-WIRING.md`), as an ILLUSTRATION… Codex is usually the sharpest CODE reviewer"* — self-labeled shop wiring, loaded.

CEREMONY — anchored list

1. **The consent gate, stated three times** — *"dispatches only on his explicit go — never self-authorized"* (Part I §2) · *"it dispatches only on the boss's explicit go, never self-authorized"* (Part VI) · *"dispatches only on the boss's explicit go"* (THE COUNCIL). The engine confesses: *"It is deliberately restated… a reflex wants redundancy."* State once.
2. **Claims-capped, stated four times** — Part V #4 *"'Gates pass,' never 'it works.' (Ladder of Truth.)"* · Mission reports *"Claims capped… never 'it works.'"* · Part I §1 · the invariant block. One rule, four copies.
3. Principle 5 — *"(Ladder of Truth, Part I §1, which owns the oracle check and the RED-first rule)"* — a pointer that restates the content it points at.
4. Part VI dispatch-gate section — *"Part I §2's two questions, applied per task"* — restatement wrapper; the only new content is the builders-vs-panel split, two lines.
5. Part VII culture lines — *"Grade the work, not the worker. A catch is a team win; a gotcha hunt is a crime."* · *"Nits don't multiply."* · *"Never a meeting."* — culture a competent review shop already has. The enforceable mechanics (severity ladder, one exchange, emergency brake) survive without the framing.
6. SKILL NON-NEGOTIABLES — *"all inherited from SPINE — restated only as the tier's guardrail card"* — restatement by its own admission.
7. SKILL delta preamble — *"The Deck adds nothing to the method… Every rule below is SPINE's"* — meta-commentary about not restating that itself restates.
8. Autonomous-hours detail — *"DECISION BATCHING"* · *"A stoppage is a pivot, not an idle"* — the binding cap already lives in Principle 8 (*"two rounds per debate… then the bell"*); the rest is unattended-mode refinement a stranger's first, attended job never fires.

THE 5,000-TOKEN ENGINE — what survives, specifically

From SPINE (~4,200):

1. **Ladder of Truth** (Part I §1), frame + four rules, scar examples stripped: "gates pass, never it works"; a gate is an arbiter only if it can fail, oracle checked, RED-first; bench catches code bugs, boss catches reality bugs, any two without the third = not yet; ambiguity is a finding, never an input. *A stranger cannot succeed without this — it is the difference between amazing and plausible slop.*
2. **Gate-0** (Part I §2): the two dispatch questions; both-no → just do it; one builder + one cross-vendor reviewer as canon; earn-a-head in one sentence; panels on the boss's explicit go — stated once.
3. **Diagnose/Design fork** (§3): bug → instrument, don't guess; novel → propose a council; re-classify when the shape changes.
4. **The Reality Contract** (§4) — all five rows, as-is. This is what makes the result land in-hand.
5. **Principle 3 + Part IV compressed**: builder never reviews; two legal paths (different effective-model vendor + lineage, or boss-launched fresh seat); a name is not a lineage; fleets declared, bounded, accounted; spawns inherit lineage and authority. *The fixed point — non-negotiable.*
6. **Preflight compressed**: probe the transport in THIS session; establish the effective model behind each host; probe the capability the ticket needs; unknown lineage fails closed; print the independence status.
7. **Adjudication** (Part V): per-finding ACCEPT/DISPUTE; BLOCKER/MATERIAL/MINOR/NOT PROVEN requiring failure mechanism + repro; repairs get fresh review; disputes escalate on strongest falsifiable evidence with a cross-lineage oracle; capped rounds, then *"convergence isn't how anything ends. A ruling is."*
8. **Three lists, containment kept mechanical**: write set frozen pre-build; delta from `git diff --name-status` + `git status --porcelain`, never the builder's account; reviewer echoes a manifest with hashes it computed; `delta ⊆ write set` and `delta ⊆ manifest` or INCOMPLETE. *The strongest anti-theater mechanic in the engine.*
9. **Ticket contract**: every section one line each, including TASK verbatim for reviewers, EXPECTED OUTCOME gradeable before dispatch, WRITE SET mandatory, and *"'I could not tell what you meant' is a good outcome. Propose, don't guess."* in every builder ticket.
10. **Review dispatch**: the four things a reviewer ticket carries; *"Never the builder's reasoning"*; *"The adversarial channel is the last thing you let fail."*
11. **Routing**: FRONTIER/WORKHORSE/FAST by judgment content, not size; cheapest seat that clearly clears the bar; review coverage never cut; any new billing surface gets asked first.
12. **Escalation + statuses**: fix ticket → retry changed → seat up or orchestrator takes over → boss rules; never a third identical retry. DONE / DONE_WITH_CONCERNS / NEEDS_CONTEXT / BLOCKED.
13. **Caps** (Principle 8): two rounds per dispute; one exchange on tone; then the judge.
14. **The human**: assigns missions, rules forks, merges; blocked seats re-plan, never delegate the block; phone-readable, outcome-first reports.
15. **Files are the shared brain** + a dated mission folder as evidence trail (no style law).
16. **Council procedure compressed**: consent-gated; brief → distinct lenses → signed independent reads → one synthesis, every idea attributed, disagreements named and resolved → cap → boss rules.
17. **Spend law compressed**: unknown cost fails closed; free before paid; a subsidy never holds the sole build/review path; every line that can spend prints a meter mark.
18. **Transport compressed**: persistent seats default; reviewers are always fresh calls; a reply-chain stays in its lineage forever; one-shots legal as fallback.
19. **The 5-line invariant block, verbatim** + every seat signs its color; the banner never lies.

From SKILL (~800): DEPENDS + version check + HALT · load receipt · plain render (model names, gold baton, no characters) · on-invocation (load SPINE → preflight → declare arsenal + independence status → "What's the job?") · the six-step checklist, one line each, wiring illustrations removed.

Cut entirely: the NOTATION glyph grammar beyond signature + meter mark, episode style law / ending credits / visuals mechanics, FUEL MODE, the seats table and wrapper scars, reserve wiring, the three-flips narrative, autonomous-hours detail beyond the bell, all dated rulings and version headings, Part VII culture framing.

WHAT I'D REGRET

1. **The meter-mark glyph discipline** (*"computed from the model id, never guessed"* — ♾️/💸/🚨💳/⚠️). Compressed to "mark spend," shops will guess, and the boss learns he spent from a footnote — the owner's stated fear. Loses badly on any metered shop.
2. **"Probe the CAPABILITY the ticket needs, not just the pulse"** — a stranger's first research dispatch is exactly where a seat that can't search dresses stale training data in fresh citations. Loses badly, once, then they re-learn it.
3. **The hash-echo and exact git commands in the three lists** — compress to "reviewer confirms what it received" and the ten-second human audit becomes trust-me. The anti-theater mechanic dulls.
4. **Autonomous-hours detail** (decision queue, batching, pivot-not-idle) — the first unattended run without it can burn a pool overnight; only the kept bell stands between the stranger and the homecoming the owner described.
5. **"A vendor's own answer is a CLAIM, not a gate"** with its banner example — one cheap line; cutting it means re-learning that dashboards lie.
6. **The episode folder as harvest source** — not load-bearing for job one, but by job ten there is no evidence trail to bottle.

CONFIDENCE

High on the homework list — every item quotes a date, a path, or text the engine itself labels *"This shop's wiring."* High on the consent-gate and claims-capped restatements — the engine confesses both (*"deliberately restated,"* *"restated only as the guardrail card"*). Medium on the 5,000-token split: the keep-list is executable as written, but the exact landing needs a measure, and two calls (notation depth, containment mechanics) are judgment calls other seats may defend. The three defenses I'll stand behind hardest: the Ladder of Truth, Principle 3 with its two legal paths, and containment — a stranger without any one of the three gets theater, not results.
